source: Senegal Code général des impôts, 'CGI annoté', read 2026-11-05 in the January 2025 edition on the DGID site (https://www.dgid.sn/storage/docs/CGI-2025.pdf) and the October 2025 edition saved in sources/. Art. 173 (Loi 2022-19): scale on the taxable income rounded down to the thousand: to 630,000 0%; to 1,500,000 20%; to 4,000,000 30%; to 8,000,000 35%; to 13,500,000 37%; to 50,000,000 40%; above 43%. Art. 174: reduction for family charges by number of parts (1 to 5; 1.5 parts 10% of the tax, min 100,000, max 300,000; ... 5 parts 45%, min 800,000, max 3,180,000), and the tax cannot exceed 43% of taxable income. Arts. 168 and 182: salaries are taxed after a 30% flat abatement for mandatory pension contributions and job expenses, at most 900,000 a year; not applied to pensions. Not modelled: the special 10% or 20% abatement for State agents posted abroad, mileage allowances, and the monthly withholding table the DGID may publish (this computes the annual tax and divides it). The reduction is read as rate x tax kept between the minimum and the maximum and never more than the tax; check that reading with the DGID. 'parts' must be one of 1, 1.5, ... 5 (the number of parts the person is entitled to under art. 174). Currency check on 2026-11-05: the October 2025 consolidated edition (after Loi 2025-17 of 27 September 2025, JO 7853) has these articles word for word as the January 2025 edition; the 2026 Finance Law, Loi 2025-19 of 22 December 2025 (JO 7873, 8 January 2026), has 25 budget articles and does not amend them; the amending finance bill for 2026 (PLFR, projet de loi 40/2026) was rejected by the National Assembly on 3 November 2026 and in any case did not touch them. A later law not found by searching could still change them.

tests.name: monthly 100000, 1 part: 30% abatement then 20% of 210000 over the first band, 42000 a year
monthly 300000, 1 part: abatement capped at 900000, base 2700000, 174000 + 360000 a year
monthly 300000, 3 parts: reduction 25% is 133500, raised to the minimum 400000
